seoDescription: Answers to common questions about TeKStak Studios packages: prices, time frames, revisions, editing your own site and maintenance.
intro: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Fill in the form on the contact page. We email you back, and WhatsApp opens with your message so you can chat with us straight away.

questions.question: How long does a website take?
questions.answer: A Landing Page or Basic website takes about 2 weeks, a Standard website about 3 weeks and a Premium website about 4 weeks. Time frames depend on how quickly you send us your content and feedback.

questions.question: How many revisions do I get?
questions.answer: Landing Page and Basic include 2 rounds of changes. Standard and Premium include 3. A round is one batch of changes you send us together.

questions.question: Can I edit the website myself?
questions.answer: Standard and Premium come with an editing screen where you can change text and photos. On Landing Page and Basic we make the changes for you.

questions.question: Do you offer help after launch?
questions.answer: Yes. Optional monthly maintenance plans start at R500 a month. Hosting and domain costs are quoted separately.

questions.question: What if I need more pages?
questions.answer: Extra pages are R500 each on Basic, R450 on Standard and R400 on Premium.

questions.question: Where are you based?
questions.answer: We are based in Pretoria, South Africa, and work with small businesses and individuals.
